# Hackathon submission checklist

## Required for submission
- [ ] Public GitHub repository
- [ ] Project page completed on the hackathon site (pitch/description, Microsoft technologies used)
- [ ] Demo video **under 2 minutes**, public on YouTube/Vimeo, showing the project actually working
- [ ] Working demo link or test build, with testing instructions (and credentials if private)
- [ ] Demo stays live and free until judging ends
- [ ] All materials in English
- [ ] Project newly built after 29 September 2026

## Content rules
- Synthetic, football-realistic data only; no real match footage or data.
- No third-party trademarks or copyrighted music in the video or app.
- Open-source dependencies must be used under their licences.
- Nothing offensive, political or promoting alcohol, drugs or tobacco.

## Judging criteria (equal weight, 20% each)
1. **Technological Implementation:** synthetic data creation, code quality, hero technologies
   (Microsoft Foundry, Agent Framework, Azure MCP, GitHub Copilot Agent Mode, Fabric, Azure services).
2. **Agentic Design & Innovation:** agent orchestration, MCP integration, multi-agent collaboration.
3. **Real-World Impact:** significance and production readiness.
4. **User Experience & Presentation:** UX, demo video clarity, frontend/backend balance.
5. **Category Fit:** target is **Best Multi-Agent Orchestration**: distinct agent roles, shared state,
   handoffs, recovery from failures, an outcome one agent could not achieve alone.

## Challenge pipeline (Stage One pass/fail)
Ingest → Interpret → Explain → Render → Personalise, plus narratives, explainability,
data innovation and multi-language output.
